lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish hint, finish new_flow, finish redesign, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder).
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests) and choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in any test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no winning effect was demonstrated, with three showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign (3 tests) and sign_in hint (2 tests), results disagree and lack a reliable winning pattern, as each had only one winning test.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a split-column layout, showcasing live companion previews on one side and customization controls on the other.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the main setup steps (66.2%) and a long mean duration of 1017s.

pick_friend.headline: Customize Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select your companion's appearance and preview how they look on your desktop.
